BODYATTACK.name: LES MILLS BODYATTACK
BODYATTACK.text: A high-energy cardio class built on athletic, explosive movement. Sports-style drills mixed with strength moves build all-round fitness, endurance and stamina.

BODYPUMP.name: LES MILLS BODYPUMP
BODYPUMP.text: Les Mills' original barbell class: light-to-moderate weights and high repetitions work every major muscle group to build lean strength, tone up and burn calories — all set to motivating music.

SHAPES.name: LES MILLS SHAPES
SHAPES.text: A low-impact, high-output full-body class that blends sculpt training, Pilates and power yoga. It builds strength and shape without lifting heavy weights, in 30- or 45-minute formats.

CEREMONY.name: LES MILLS CEREMONY
CEREMONY.text: Les Mills' HYROX-partnership class: high-performance strength and cardio training that moves you through eight functional workout stations. The coach-led, music-driven format builds strength, fitness and stamina, with the group's energy carrying you from one station to the next. (FAC runs it as Ceremony — Hyrox and Ceremony — Stations.)

GRIT.name: LES MILLS GRIT
GRIT.text: A 30-minute high-intensity interval workout that pushes you hard. Offered in Strength, Cardio and Athletic styles, it builds lean muscle, speed and stamina in a focused, coach-led session.

SPRINT.name: LES MILLS SPRINT
SPRINT.text: A 30-minute high-intensity interval ride that delivers big results in little time. Science-backed bursts of hard effort and recovery push your limits on the bike.

RPM.name: LES MILLS RPM
RPM.text: Les Mills' original indoor cycling class. Ride to the beat through science-backed intervals — low-impact but high-energy — setting your own intensity on the bike.

STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.name: LES MILLS STRENGTH DEVELOPMENT
STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT.text: A science-backed, progressive resistance-training program done in a group setting. Steadily increasing the load over time builds real muscle and strength.

CORE.name: LES MILLS CORE
CORE.text: A short (30–45 minute) class that strengthens the muscles around your core — abs, glutes and back. Science-backed exercises build the stability and control that carry over to sport and everyday movement, and help guard against injury. (Formerly CXWORX.)

TONE.name: LES MILLS TONE
TONE.text: An all-round, full-body class mixing cardio, strength and core work. It's built to boost athleticism and movement control while helping you get fit and toned — a great everyday option.

WAYMO_HYROX.name: WAYMO HYROX
WAYMO_HYROX.text: A 50-minute cross-training class on the WAYMO court, led by a personal trainer, with daily-rotating workouts that build strength, speed, and agility. The early-morning session has a breakfast club for early risers.

FAST_FEED.name: Fast Feed Tennis
FAST_FEED.text: A fast-paced, heart-racing 50-minute tennis workout in the Tennis Center — fun, social, and welcoming to all tennis levels. Fee-based class.

BARRE.name: Barre Intensity
BARRE.text: A 50-minute barre class blending Pilates and dance: controlled movements work muscles to fatigue while keeping the heart rate up, for a full upper- and lower-body workout.

HOT_CARDIO_SCULPT.name: Hot Cardio Sculpt
HOT_CARDIO_SCULPT.text: A 50-minute heated yoga class that leans into cardio — a high-intensity flow built for intermediate-to-advanced participants. Bring a yoga mat and towel.

DANCEFIIT.name: DanceFIIT
DANCEFIIT.text: A high-energy, 50-minute dance-cardio class with strength-training intervals woven in — it lifts the mood while it tones and sculpts, and the high intensity keeps the calorie burn up throughout.

FULL_BODY_TONE.name: Full Body Tone
FULL_BODY_TONE.text: A 50-minute early-morning class that combines barre and Pilates with cardio and light strength training — the barre-and-Pilates burn delivers full-body, head-to-toe results.
